title: 庞经理
warn: A haunted night shift: a sad phone call about a death long ago, told gently, no gore. It ends safe.

series.next: Six o'clock. An old man is walking slowly towards the store, in a 1998 uniform.

setting: The convenience store, your fifth night. At three you rang the number in the logbook, and nobody answered. At four, it rings back.

pang.name: 庞经理
pang.en: the store manager in 1998, an old man now

silence.en: Did you... get the wrong number?

hangup.en: The line goes dead. At six, nobody comes. Run that back.

missed.en: Who... called this number just now?

say.en: Pick up, and ask: is this 庞经理?
say.tip: 经理 jīnglǐ = manager. 庞 Páng is his surname.

ok.zh: ……这个号码，二十多年没人打了。
ok.en: ...Nobody's rung this number in more than twenty years.
Who are you? Where are you calling from?

ok.narr: You tell him: the night shift. The store.

answers: 喂，您好，请问是庞经理吗？
4.gloss: Hello, good evening. Is that 庞经理, please?

say.en: Ask him: does he remember 老韩?
answers: 庞经理，您还记得老韩吗？
say.gloss: Do you still remember 老韩?
say.tip: 还记得 = still remember: 还 hái = still.

ok.narr: A long silence. You can hear him breathing.

answers: 您还记得一九九八年的老韩吗？
4.gloss: Do you remember 老韩, from 1998?

steps.narr: You tell him: the handover form has your name on it now.

else.narr: You tell him: the handover form is still blank.

say.en: Ask him, gently: what happened that morning?
say.tip: 发生 fāshēng = happen. 发生了什么？ = what happened?

ok.zh: 一九九八年七月三日。早上六点，该接班了。
ok.en: The third of July, 1998. Six in the morning, time for the handover.
That day, the one taking over was me.

ok.zh: 我到的时候，他坐在柜台后面，像睡着了一样。
ok.en: When I got there, he was sitting behind the counter, as if he'd fallen asleep.

ok.zh: 心脏不好。他从来没跟我说过。
ok.en: A weak heart. He never once told me.

ok.zh: 钱，一分不差。接班人那一行，空着。
ok.en: The till was right to the fen. The line for whoever took over was blank.

ok.zh: 二十八年了，我再也没进过那家店。
ok.en: In twenty-eight years, I've never set foot in that store again.

fail.en: ...I don't want to talk about it.

answers: 您慢慢说，那天早上发生了什么？
4.gloss: Take your time. What happened that morning?

say.en: Tell him: it wasn't his fault.
say.gloss: 庞经理, it wasn't your fault.
say.tip: 错 cuò = fault, mistake: 这不是您的错 = this isn't your fault.

ok.narr: On the line, an old man crying, very quietly.

ok.en: He's waited twenty-eight years for me.
What... can I still do now?

answers: 庞经理，那天的事，不是您的错。
4.gloss: 庞经理, what happened that day wasn't your fault.

say.en: Ask him to come and take over from 老韩, or offer to tell 老韩 for him.
answers: 庞经理，您来接他的班吧。
say.gloss: 庞经理, come and take over from him.
say.tip: 接他的班 = take over his shift: the handover, at last.

alts.en: Or: tell 老韩 for him

then.zh: 你跟他说：对不起，我来晚了。
then.en: Tell him: I'm sorry. I came too late.

answers: 庞经理，六点，您来接他的班吧。
4.gloss: 庞经理, six o'clock: come and take over from him.

answers: 您放心，我替您跟老韩说。
alts.gloss: Don't worry. I'll tell 老韩 for you.

steps.en: 4:40. 庞经理 hangs up to look for his old uniform. The fridges hum. 🌅

else.en: 4:40. You write 庞经理's sorry on a sticky note, and put it on the till. 🌅
